__comment: Opt-in WARM neutrals (calm kit 2.56), for comparing against the default cool greys before a decision is made. Scoped: it applies only under <html data-uix-neutral="warm">, so importing it changes nothing until a product sets the attribute. Only the neutral surface, border and text tokens move; status, brand and chart colours stay. Contrast is checked in tests/neutral-warm.test.mjs.
